vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: compound-eng-file-todos
Version: 3.0.0

The skill bundle implements a structured, file-based todo tracking system. It uses standard Markdown templates and basic shell commands (ls, grep, mv) to manage task lifecycles within a local 'todos/' directory. No malicious patterns, data exfiltration, or suspicious execution logic were found in SKILL.md or the reference workflows.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only, file-based todo workflow that is internally consistent with its stated purpose; it does reference optional tooling/integrations that are not declared as requirements but nothing in the instructions demands elevated secrets or installers.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the provided instructions: the skill defines a file-based todo format, templates, and workflows operating on a todos/ directory. Minor mismatch: the docs mention integrations (slash commands, 'gh CLI', review agent + skill) without declaring those as required binaries or environment variables; these are presented as optional integrations rather than required capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and reference files limit activity to creating, renaming, searching, and updating markdown files in todos/ and asset template usage. It includes shell snippets (ls, grep, mv, cp) and a suggested slash-command/gh CLI workflow; none of the instructions attempt to read unrelated system paths, environment variables, or transmit data to external endpoints. The mention of interactive slash-commands and gh CLI suggests optional external integrations that are not fully specified.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — nothing is written to disk by an installer. This is the lowest-risk install model.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars or credentials, which aligns with a local file-based todo manager. As a minor inconsistency, the workflow references gh CLI and PR/comment integration but does not request GH credentials (e.g., GITHUB_TOKEN); if you plan to use those integrations, expect to supply appropriate credentials separately.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and disable-model-invocation:true — the skill will not be autonomously invoked and is not forced into every agent run. The skill does not request system-wide configuration changes or other skills' credentials.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This appears to be a straightforward, instruction-only skill for managing markdown todos in a todos/ folder. Before installing: (1) confirm you want agents to edit files in your repository (this skill assumes write access to todos/); (2) if you intend to use the mentioned PR/comment or gh CLI integrations, plan for providing GitHub credentials separately and validate what commands the integration will run; (3) because the skill uses shell snippets (mv, grep, etc.), review any automation that will run those commands to ensure it won't accidentally rename/move files you care about. Because model invocation is disabled, the skill cannot act autonomously — you must call it explicitly, which reduces risk.
